title: GUNS IN HAND, EVEN BIGGER
why: His answer 42: the guns in the hands are "even bigger". The held gun, both arms and the hands are now drawn thirty percent larger from the same shoulder point, on top of the size they got in v25.26 and v25.60, for you and for pillagers alike. The flash of a shot now sits on the drawn muzzle, the brass leaves the drawn ejection port, and a tracer starts at the muzzle instead of inside the gun. The round itself does not move: it still leaves 17 units out with the same speed, spread, range and damage, and nothing a fight reads has changed. Cosmetic only.
now: The guns in your hands are bigger again, and the muzzle flash, tracer and brass come from the end of the barrel.
